messages:
Cara: Quick ask  partner wants a minimal TF usage snippet + packaging checklist for the cloud refkit. Keep it one copy-paste file.
Vik: I'll add a module usage example and expected outputs.
Jun: I'll draft the manifest.json sample and include digest-pin guidance.
Priya: I'll own the smoke test and pass criteria. Also add a short network allowlist note.
Vik: TF snippet (to paste into quickstart):
```
module "refkit_partner" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refkit-terraform//modules/partner?ref=v0.3.0"
  region = "us-east-1"
  refkit_vpc_id = "vpc-0a1b2c3d"
  kms_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd"
}
output "endpoint" { value = module.refkit_partner.endpoint }
```
Priya: Smoke test (CI-friendly): `ENDPOINT=$(terraform output -raw endpoint); curl -s -X POST "${ENDPOINT}/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'` expect HTTP 200 + non-empty output.
Jun: Manifest snippet will include image digest and a short model metadata example.
packaging-bot: Reminder: marketplace packaging cutoff 2026-04-12 23:59 UTC. Submit images + manifest 48h before.
Cara: Plan: PRs by Thu EOD, internal review Fri. Assignments set. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
